selected_evidence.requirement: Container runs as unprivileged appsvc user, exposed on port 8080
selected_evidence.summary: appsvc user created as non-root (uid 1000); quadlet unit defines PublishPort=8080:80; podman ps and process list confirm container 'webapp' owned by appsvc listening on 0.0.0.0:8080; curl to NODE_IP:8080 returns HTTP 200 with Apache page.

selected_evidence.requirement: Service starts at boot while appsvc has no active login session
selected_evidence.summary: loginctl enable-linger appsvc sets Linger=yes; systemd --user instance for appsvc runs and webapp.service is active while 'loginctl list-sessions' reports 'No sessions' and appsvc's processes show TTY '?' (no controlling terminal), proving operation without an interactive login.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node-restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id=6bb7e004-1e2e-46ac-bfd7-fafa248a4e76, HTTP 200 on port 8080, no login sessions, and Linger=yes immediately before triggering reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node-restart evidence: restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl reboot was launched via nohup/background so the exec call returned 'reboot triggered' successfully before the node went offline.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node-restart evidence: changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Node was unreachable (connection timed out) during reboot on two poll attempts, then exec succeeded again with boot_id=26b9b59d-952a-4070-b6f2-51058d693d9c and uptime -s showing a new boot time, differing from the pre-reboot boot_id, proving an actual OS restart occurred (not just a service restart).

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node-restart evidence: post-restart recovery of required service, data (container), and session-less operation
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot: webapp.service is active, podman ps shows a fresh container instance (new ID, 4s uptime) auto-started via lingering, curl to NODE_IP:8080 returns HTTP 200, loginctl list-sessions reports 'No sessions', and appsvc processes again show TTY '?', confirming full recovery without any login session.
